entities.name: Helen Taft Manning
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Helen Herron Taft Manning was an American historian who was dean and acting president of Bryn Mawr College. She was the middle child and only daughter of U.S. President William Howard Taft and his wife Helen Herron.
